idea-plugin.name: Solstice Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Solstice Themes is a focused dark theme family for JetBrains IDEs. The free plugin includes three complete variants with coordinated editor, tabs, project tree, gutter, popup, and tool window colors.

If the Marketplace screenshots look different, that is intentional: Moon, Sun, and Star are separate moods, not one theme with a single swapped accent color.

  • Solstice Moon - a cool blue night palette with calm contrast and clean cyan highlights for long focused sessions.
  • Solstice Sun - a warmer dusk palette with amber, copper, and soft brown UI tones for a cozy editor feel.
  • Solstice Star - a deep violet space palette with lavender syntax, crisp tabs, and brighter celestial accents.

Color previews:

Solstice Sun - warm amber tabs, dark espresso editor surfaces, and copper-orange syntax accents.

Solstice Star - deep violet panels, lavender keywords, gold highlights, and a softer cosmic contrast.

Solstice Moon - cool blue sidebars, crisp cyan syntax, rose keywords, and a clean midnight editor tone.

The free edition is theme-only: it changes the visual language of the IDE without adding background workflow features. Install Solstice Pro to add animated harbor details and marker tools.
